suggestion.title: Draw the Eyes Upward
suggestion.body: To balance wider hips, draw attention to your upper body by wearing boat necks, cowl necks, or tops with ruffled details. Pair them with darker, muted bottoms.

suggestion.title: Balance the Upper Body
suggestion.body: To create a broader chest profile, try layering jackets or wearing lighter-colored shirts. Dark, straight-leg trousers will keep the lower body looking sharp and tailored.

characteristics: Shoulders are slimmer compared to the hips
Defined hips that are wider than the shoulders

do: Bold prints & patterns (especially floral and stripes)

recommended_items.advice: Bootcut jeans balance fuller hips and thighs by adding gentle flare below the knee rather than clinging tightly.
Wide-leg jeans skim over the hips and thighs, creating a balanced line from waist to hem.
Straight-leg jeans provide a clean drop from hip to hem without adding extra volume where you already have curves.

avoid_items.advice: Skinny jeans can cling to fuller hips and thighs, drawing attention to the widest part of your frame -- a relaxed leg through the hip balances things better.

general_advice: Choose high or mid-rise jeans to define your waist, and look for flare details at the hem to keep your lower half in proportion.

recommended_items.advice: A fitted, structured top balances narrower shoulders against fuller hips.
A classic shirt adds definition up top, drawing the eye upward.

avoid_items.advice: An oversized top makes narrower shoulders look even smaller relative to your hips.

recommended_items.advice: A snug fit on top helps balance narrower shoulders against fuller hips.
Tulip dresses skim gently over the hips without clinging, keeping the lower half streamlined.
A-line dresses skim over fuller hips for a balanced, streamlined silhouette.
X-line dresses nip in at the waist and glide over the hips, balancing shoulders and hips.
Empire-waist dresses skim past the hips entirely, keeping the focus on your upper body.
Off-shoulder dresses widen the shoulder line, balancing it against fuller hips.
Wrap dresses define the waist while skimming smoothly over the hips.
A belted waist draws the eye upward, creating a defined midpoint between shoulders and hips.
